data.narrative:
Aslan is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $20.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, alongside 2 public Defense & Security names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 additional private frontier-tech companies in the space including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $51M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 same-sector comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yields a median of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis across these two methods supports a valuation range of $43M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $375M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Aslan's relative competitive positioning and technology maturity versus peers. Stage-progression implies the lower bound; peer-median implies the upper bound. Resolution of this range will depend on evidence of product differentiation, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the sampled comparables.
